scope: Book Two, authored Chapters 1–5: dialogue continuity, natural speaking tone and unnecessary repetition

findings_and_edits.finding: Seth's vague school answer and Billy's examination wording made the conversation unclear or overly formal. The correction exchange repeated a lesson immediately before the narration demonstrated it.
findings_and_edits.edit: Made Seth name his finals and homework, used everyday American wording, shortened the correction exchange and gave Billy direct encouragement. Graduation still depends on Seth doing the work.

findings_and_edits.finding: Flaming Head's instructions sounded like polished maxims and appeared to invite an uncontrolled kick. Jenny repeated the targeting lesson after it had already been taught.
findings_and_edits.edit: Jenny kicks before Flaming Head finishes his caution. His later instruction names the target and the action. Kept the exact rest-and-focus conditions for Seth's ability to lift or bend any earthly substance, using spoken contractions. Removed Jenny's second statement of the same lesson.

findings_and_edits.finding: The drum was described as being back even though it never left. The conversation repeated both accidents, and some reassurance sounded abstract rather than responsive.
findings_and_edits.edit: Changed the opening joke to a rematch. Jenny now worries about who could have been hurt; Seth talks about the pressure to appear competent. Their reassurance gives each other time instead of repeating training instructions. Removed an explanatory sentence already demonstrated by the next missed kick.

findings_and_edits.finding: The editor's award speech overlapped the reflective mentor voices. Hearing a rooftop door from Jenny's apartment depended on an unestablished building layout.
findings_and_edits.edit: Made the editor's praise brief and work-focused. Used the scheduled practice time to motivate Jenny changing, without assuming what she can hear from her apartment. The chapter remains short with one award illustration.

findings_and_edits.finding: Jenny's explanation sounded administrative, Larry stacked several general maxims, and the shoe clerk's line sounded like another knowing hint.
findings_and_edits.edit: Made Jenny's complaint conversational, shortened Larry's follow-up advice, and gave the clerk a practical observation about shoe durability. Preserved Larry's words-and-actions advice, his finger beside the pink-blur photograph and uncertainty about what he knows.

continuity_preserved: Seth graduates with Billy's tutoring before rooftop training.
Seth's lift-and-bend ability depends on rest and focus; Jenny generates kickable plasma through rapid leg movement.
Chapter 2 contains the failures; Chapter 3 contains growing trust and improved but imperfect control.
Jenny's award and promotion precede the increased duties in Chapter 5.
Larry Jenkins is Jenny's grandpa and the retired Defender editor; his knowledge of her secret is not confirmed.
Jenny wears civilian clothes throughout Chapter 5; her speed is used between reporting stops away from onlookers.
Flaming Head's private training dialogue remains with Seth and Jenny, who understand him. No ordinary bystander is made to understand his shared-energy speech.
No new powers, identities, villain reveals or rescue outcomes are introduced.
All ten existing illustration references and their associated scenes remain in place.

verification.reader_checks: npm test passed; all five Book Two chapters match their authoritative source, images load, navigation and independent book progress work, and layouts pass at 320, 390 and 1200 pixels
verification.exact_dialogue_repetition: No repeated complete speech passage of four or more words after normalization. Manual review also addressed repeated explanations and mentor phrasing.
